kohs_anchors.screen.title: KoHs Anchor's
kohs_anchors.screen.subtitle: Anchor and glowstone, exactly as you pressed them
kohs_anchors.option.input_order.descript: When use and hotbar keys land in the same tick, they are applied in the order you pressed them. Vanilla applies every number key first, so a fast place, glowstone, detonate could use the wrong item.
kohs_anchors.option.fresh_target.descrip: A second use in the same tick aims at what your crosshair hits after the first one, like the anchor you just placed, instead of the block that was there before.
kohs_anchors.option.predict_detonation.d: The explosion's sound and flash play the moment you use a charged anchor, not one round trip later. Damage, knockback and blocks still come from the server.
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_debris.descri: Block debris particles of anchor explosions. Turning them off saves frames in anchor fights; other explosions keep theirs.
kohs_anchors.option.interface_motion.des: Floating particles, entrance effects and the animated anchor on this screen.
kohs_anchors.stats.title: This session
kohs_anchors.footer.note: Every action is your own click. The server decides.
